command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
# #997 MIGRATION — MIG-10a. Rollback capture and the one open question, before compose is edited.
#
# The owner's packet says to preserve open-webui's ability to reach the new loopback service and to
# record what that requires. open-webui reaches Ollama today as http://ollama:11434 over the compose
# bridge network -- a path that disappears with the stanza. Whether a container can reach a service
# bound to the HOST's 127.0.0.1 is a genuine question with a real answer either way: on Docker
# Desktop the host.docker.internal path is proxied by a component running ON the host, which would
# make a loopback-only listener reachable; on plain Docker Engine it would not be. Test it rather
# than reason about it, because the wrong guess either breaks open-webui silently or "fixes" it by
# opening the port the whole migration exists to close.

$stamp = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyyMMddTHHmmssZ')
$compose = 'C:\HermesLab\hermes\docker-compose.yml'
$bakDir = 'C:\HermesLab\hermes\_997-rollback'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $bakDir | Out-Null

Write-Output '--- ROLLBACK-CAPTURE ---'
Write-Output "compose_sha256_before=$((Get-FileHash $compose -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower())"
Copy-Item $compose "$bakDir\docker-compose.yml.bak-997-$stamp"
Copy-Item 'C:\HermesLab\hermes\start-hermes.ps1' "$bakDir\start-hermes.ps1.bak-997-$stamp"
docker inspect ollama 2>&1 | Out-File "$bakDir\ollama-container-inspect-$stamp.json" -Encoding utf8
docker image inspect ollama/ollama:latest 2>&1 | Out-File "$bakDir\ollama-image-inspect-$stamp.json" -Encoding utf8
Get-ChildItem $bakDir -File | ForEach-Object { "backup $($_.Name) bytes=$($_.Length) sha256=$((Get-FileHash $_.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower())" }
Write-Output "ROLLBACK_PROCEDURE=Copy-Item '$bakDir\docker-compose.yml.bak-997-$stamp' '$compose' -Force ; Copy-Item '$bakDir\start-hermes.ps1.bak-997-$stamp' 'C:\HermesLab\hermes\start-hermes.ps1' -Force ; docker compose -f '$compose' up -d ; powershell -File 'C:\HermesLab\hermes\ollama-service\install-hermes-ollama-service.ps1' -Uninstall"

Write-Output '--- CONTAINER-IMAGE-IDENTITY-PRESERVED ---'
docker inspect ollama --format '{{.Image}} {{.Config.Image}} {{.State.Status}} {{.State.ExitCode}} {{.Created}}' 2>&1
docker image inspect ollama/ollama:latest --format '{{.Id}} {{index .RepoDigests 0}}' 2>&1

Write-Output '--- SERVICE-STILL-UP ---'
Write-Output "task_state=$((Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'WilliamOS-HERMES-Ollama' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).State)"
try { Write-Output "api_version=$((Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version' -TimeoutSec 5).version)" } catch { Write-Output "api_ERR=$($_.Exception.Message)" }

Write-Output '--- CAN-OPEN-WEBUI-REACH-HOST-LOOPBACK ---'
foreach ($target in @('http://host.docker.internal:11434/api/tags', 'http://192.168.88.9:11434/api/tags', 'http://172.25.208.1:11434/api/tags')) {
    $r = docker exec open-webui python3 -c "import urllib.request,sys
try:
    d=urllib.request.urlopen('$target', timeout=6).read()
    print('OK', len(d), d[:120])
except Exception as e:
    print('FAIL', type(e).__name__, e)" 2>&1
    Write-Output "$target => $($r -join ' | ')"
}
Write-Output '--- WHAT-DOES-host.docker.internal-RESOLVE-TO ---'
docker exec open-webui getent hosts host.docker.internal 2>&1
docker exec open-webui sh -c 'cat /etc/hosts' 2>&1

Write-Output '--- CURRENT-OPEN-WEBUI-CONFIG ---'
docker inspect open-webui --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' 2>&1 | Select-String 'OLLAMA'
docker inspect open-webui --format '{{json .NetworkSettings.Networks}}' 2>&1

Write-Output '--- COMPOSE-SERVICES ---'
docker compose -f $compose --project-directory 'C:\HermesLab\hermes' config --services 2>&1
Write-Output '--- SERVE-LOG-CHECK ---'
Write-Output "serve_log_exists=$(Test-Path 'C:\ProgramData\WilliamOS\logs\hermes-ollama-serve.log')"
Write-Output "serve_log_bytes=$((Get-Item 'C:\ProgramData\WilliamOS\logs\hermes-ollama-serve.log' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Length)"
Get-Content 'C:\ProgramData\WilliamOS\logs\hermes-ollama-serve.log' -Tail 12 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Output '--- RC ---'
